KiCadRoutingTools v0.18.0 is fetched from the pinned release and verified by SHA-256 before extraction. Installation applies only the reviewed, manifest-declared single-ended length-matching candidate-error comparison patch (revision 2026.11.15.1) to the private user runtime. The manifest records the upstream and patched source hashes. No upstream batch router is run; the installed upstream source is not modified at import time.
